map.3932423: Castlewars chinchompa: Place these on the ground in proximity mode and they'll explode if the enemy gets too near. Use timer mode and they will run forwards, exploding after a few seconds. Can only be used on the ground floor of the arena, outside the fortress walls. You get three per ticket.
